administering_agency: Arizona Department of Gaming, Division of Problem Gambling
enrollment_method: Notarized form by mail (in person by appointment; remote online notary accepted)
notes: Two separate lists, two forms: (1) all Class III tribal casinos statewide incl. casino hotels/restaurants/venues; (2) event wagering (retail + mobile sportsbooks) and fantasy contests. Lottery not covered. Terms 1, 5 or 10 years; irrevocable, no removal process, name drops off when the term ends. Current photo required. selfexclusion@azgaming.gov, 602-771-4263.

administering_agency: California Department of Justice, Bureau of Gambling Control
enrollment_method: Online (ems.doj.ca.gov) or paper form notarized or witnessed by a licensed cardroom key employee
notes: Licensed card rooms statewide only — explicitly not tribal casinos, horse racing or lottery (tribal casinos are reached through NVSEP). Terms 1 year or lifetime; irrevocable for the term. Jackpots won while excluded are confiscated to the Office of Problem Gambling. A separate cardroom-level self-restriction (30 days to lifetime) also exists. BGCEMS@doj.ca.gov, 916-830-1700.

enrollment_method: Online
notes: Enroll through the Division of Gaming's program at betsmart.colorado.gov.

enrollment_method: Online
notes: Enroll online. Covers online platforms and retail sports wagering statewide.

enrollment_method: In person only (Dover office, by appointment 302-744-1669); mail not accepted
notes: Covers all three racinos (slots, tables and their iGaming sites) plus the Lottery's iGaming and sports app. Retail lottery not covered. Terms 1 year, 5 years or lifetime; lifetime irrevocable; 1- and 5-year terms must be served in full, then the person must appear in person to request reinstatement (not automatic). Class A misdemeanor if caught; winnings forfeited.

enrollment_method: Online or in person (online form at forms.dc.gov; in person at OLG by appointment or at any licensed sportsbook facility)
notes: One list covering all OLG-regulated gambling: sports wagering (retail + mobile), DC Lottery retail tickets, iLottery and prize claims; cannot be limited to one type. Terms 18 months, 3 years, 5 years or lifetime; irrevocable for the term; NOT removed automatically at expiry — a removal request must be filed. Government photo ID and SSN required. 202-788-2102.

enrollment_method: By phone (1-800-GA-LUCKY) or from the iHOPE account profile
notes: Online/mobile lottery (draw games, Diggi, second-chance) and Players Club only; retail tickets not covered; no casinos or sports betting in Georgia. Irrevocable for the term; not reinstated automatically at expiry — the person must call. Term menu differs between the web page (3 months to 10 years) and the program terms PDF (3 to 12 months) — official sources conflict (UNVERIFIED).

enrollment_method: In person only
notes: Enroll at an Illinois Gaming Board office or any Illinois casino. Covers all casinos and sports wagering.

enrollment_method: Online, at any Indiana casino, or at the IGC office
notes: Voluntary Exclusion Program.

enrollment_method: Notarized form by mail, or in person (IRGC Des Moines, any Iowa Gambling Treatment Program agency, or any licensed casino/racetrack); no web form
notes: One statewide list for all IRGC licensees: casinos, racetrack casinos, sports wagering (retail + online), fantasy sports and advance-deposit wagering. Lottery not covered. Terms 5 years or lifetime, both final and irrevocable (revocation only for pre-July-2017 enrollees). Notarized mail-in needs a photo and copy of government ID. Up to two weeks for licensees to enforce; winnings forfeited.

enrollment_method: In person at any of the four state-owned casinos or the Topeka office (casino VEP); online by secure document upload (sports wagering)
notes: Two separate programs: (1) Voluntary Exclusion Program for the four state-owned casinos (Boot Hill, Kansas Star, Hollywood at Kansas Speedway, Kansas Crossing) — terms 2 years or lifetime; after 2 years removal requires a problem-gambling assessment and course series, then Commission approval; (2) Sports Wagering Exclusion Program, statewide retail + mobile, enrolled by email request and secure upload (https://krgc.kansas.gov/problem-gambling/sports-wagering-exclusion-program/); term lengths set on the form (UNVERIFIED); no early removal. Tribal casinos and lottery not covered.

administering_agency: Kentucky Horse Racing and Gaming Corporation (compiles a statewide list; enrollment is through operators)
enrollment_method: Operator-level only: enroll at any licensed sportsbook or racetrack; operators forward weekly and the Corporation redistributes monthly
notes: No central enrollment page, form or phone line is published — the statewide list exists in regulation (809 KAR 10:007; 810 KAR 2:100) and is populated by operators. Covers sports wagering (retail + mobile) and pari-mutuel racetracks once compiled. Terms set by operators ('temporarily or permanently' per rule); removal procedure UNVERIFIED.

administering_agency: Louisiana Gaming Control Board, via State Police Gaming Enforcement Division
enrollment_method: In person only (LSP Gaming field offices: Baton Rouge, Breaux Bridge, Lake Charles, New Orleans, Bossier City)
notes: Covers riverboat casinos, the land-based casino, racetrack slot facilities and all sports wagering (retail + mobile). Video poker and lottery not covered. Minimum 5 years, indefinite until removed; removal is not automatic — after 5 years, a written request, a mental-health professional's recommendation and a closed hearing. Winnings forfeited; arrest possible. 225-925-1900.

administering_agency: Maine Gambling Control Unit (Dept. of Public Safety); virtual enrollment via AdCare Maine
enrollment_method: Online (virtual session via AdCare Maine) or in person (Gambling Control Unit, Hollywood Casino Bangor, Oxford Casino, AdCare offices); or request through an online wagering operator
notes: One universal list; applicant chooses which activities to exclude from: casinos/slot facilities, sports wagering, fantasy contests, advance-deposit wagering. Lottery not covered. Terms 1, 3, 5 years or lifetime; fixed terms end automatically at month-end of the enrollment anniversary, no early removal; lifetime may be petitioned after 5 years with a reinstatement session from an approved problem-gambling agency. Governed by Chapter 13 (adopted Oct 2025). AdCare virtual enrollment: 207-626-3615 x20.

administering_agency: Maryland Lottery and Gaming Control Agency
enrollment_method: In person
notes: Enroll in person at a casino or at the Lottery and Gaming Control Agency.

enrollment_method: In-person appointment
notes: Enroll through GameSense: an appointment at a casino GameSense center or with the Gaming Commission.

enrollment_method: Online (internet gaming) / in person (casinos)
notes: Disassociated Persons List covers casinos; a separate internet-gaming self-exclusion can be done online.

enrollment_method: Online (selfexclusionforms.msgamingcommission.com, email one-time code; devices available at Commission offices)
notes: Covers all state-regulated casinos (whole property) including casino sportsbooks. Lottery and bingo not covered; no mobile sports betting in MS. Term 3 to 10 years, selectable; lifetime available only after completing a prior term of at least 3 years. No early removal; expires automatically (casinos have up to 10 days to update); extend by logging back in. Selfie and ID upload. 228-297-8174.

enrollment_method: Online (MGC portal with ID and photo upload) or in person (any casino's MGC office or Jefferson City)
notes: Two independent lists: (1) List of Disassociated Persons covers all 13 licensed casinos; lifetime, with a one-time petition for removal after 5 years (re-enrolling after removal is permanent); (2) Self-Excluded Persons list for sports wagering (retail + mobile), 5-year term, removed automatically at expiry and extendable in the final 3 months (https://mgc.dps.mo.gov/DAP/dap_about.html). File both to cover both. Applicant must be unimpaired when applying; violation is misdemeanor trespass with forfeiture.

administering_agency: Montana Lottery (Sports Bet Montana) — sports wagering only
enrollment_method: Per rule ARM 2.63.1304, by the procedure published at montanalottery.com (reported in-app); no public enrollment page could be confirmed (UNVERIFIED)
notes: Lottery-run sports wagering only. Video gambling machines, card rooms (Department of Justice) and tribal casinos have no statewide program; draw and scratch lottery not covered. The rule allows removal by the published procedure, so the exclusion is not irrevocable. Enrollment URL unpublished.

administering_agency: Nebraska Racing and Gaming Commission, via the National Voluntary Self-Exclusion Program
enrollment_method: Online (nvsep.org)
notes: Nebraska routes state self-exclusion through NVSEP: covers the racetrack casinos and retail sports betting at them (no online sports betting in NE). Term menu and early-removal rules not stated on the official page (UNVERIFIED).

administering_agency: New Hampshire Lottery Commission (iLottery; sports wagering via its agent DraftKings)
enrollment_method: Online (iLottery account self-exclusion); operator-level in the DraftKings app for sports wagering
notes: Lottery self-exclusion covers NH iLottery and My603Rewards only, 1, 3 or 6 months, cannot be undone early. Sports wagering exclusion is enrolled through DraftKings (the Commission keeps a central database under Lot 3003.05); charitable casinos not covered. A statewide database for all NH gaming was authorized in 2025 and is not yet live (UNVERIFIED; re-check).

enrollment_method: Online
notes: Enroll online. Covers online gaming statewide; choose online-only or all gambling.

enrollment_method: In person only (Albuquerque office by appointment, 505-841-9700, or approved locations); mail not accepted
notes: Statewide option covers racetrack casinos and participating tribal casinos; single-property exclusion also available through that casino. Gaming floor only; lottery not covered; no mobile sports betting in NM. Terms 1 year, 5 years or lifetime. Removal possible by written petition after at least 1 year, decided by the Board within 90 days. Government photo ID required; photographed on site; winnings forfeited to the Compulsive Gambling Treatment Fund.

enrollment_method: Notarized form by mail or in person
notes: Download the Voluntary Self-Exclusion form, have it notarized, and submit it by mail or in person.

administering_agency: North Carolina State Lottery Commission, Regulated Gaming Division
enrollment_method: Online (DocuSign web form) or in person at an NC Education Lottery claims center
notes: Covers sports wagering (online + retail) and pari-mutuel/advance-deposit horse wagering. Lottery and tribal casinos not covered. Terms 1, 3, 5 years or lifetime; removed automatically at term end; early removal only by petition for mistaken identity or fraud. Account funds refunded; winnings during exclusion forfeited; takes effect in about 3–4 business days. (morethanagame.nc.gov is NCDHHS's help site, not an enrollment path.)

administering_agency: Ohio Casino Control Commission (Time Out Ohio)
enrollment_method: Online
notes: Enroll online in Time Out Ohio, the state's voluntary exclusion program.

administering_agency: Oklahoma Association on Problem Gambling and Gaming (nonprofit administering the statewide tribal-casino list under compact requirements) — casinos; Oklahoma Lottery Commission — lottery
enrollment_method: Notarized form by mail (casino list: OAPGG, Norman; lottery: Lottery HQ, Oklahoma City)
notes: Not a state-agency program: the statewide casino list is run by a nonprofit and covers participating tribal casinos only (17 tribal gaming commissions plus Remington Park on the form; not every tribe participates). Terms 1, 3, 5 or 10 years; irrevocable for the term; at expiry removal is per-casino and the person must contact each facility. Driver's license copy plus a recent photo required. Separate lifetime-only Lottery self-exclusion (prizes over $600, Players Club, marketing) at https://oklottery.com/play-responsibly/self-exclusion. No commercial sportsbooks in OK. help@oapgg.org, 405-801-3329.

enrollment_method: Online
notes: Four separate tracks: casinos, online gambling, video gaming terminals, and fantasy. Enroll in each you need.

administering_agency: Rhode Island Lottery (iLottery); Bally's casinos (casino and sportsbook) under Lottery oversight
enrollment_method: Online or by phone (iLottery, 1-800-288-2485); in person only at Bally's Lincoln security for the casinos and sportsbook
notes: Two tracks with different owners: (1) Lottery self-exclusion covers the iLottery account only, 1 or 5 years, auto-restored at term end; (2) casino and sportsbook exclusion (Bally's Lincoln and Tiverton; Bally Bet online coverage UNVERIFIED) is operator-run, in person, 1 year, 5 years or permanent, early termination only with Bally's and Lottery approval (https://casinos.ballys.com/lincoln/responsible-gaming.htm). No standalone state enrollment page for the casinos.

administering_agency: South Dakota Commission on Gaming (Department of Revenue)
enrollment_method: Online (state e-form 4014 with ID and photo upload) or through any licensee, forwarded within 24 hours
notes: Covers Deadwood licensed casinos (slots, tables, Deadwood retail sports wagering). Tribal casinos and Lottery video lottery not covered. The Commission took over the registry from individual casinos effective June 15, 2026. Term options and reversal policy not legible on the official form (UNVERIFIED). 605-578-3074.

enrollment_method: Online (web form), by phone (615-253-7922), or by mailed/emailed PDF; any licensed sportsbook can forward a statewide request
notes: Online sports wagering only (Tennessee has no casinos). Fantasy sports not covered — per-operator only. Terms 1, 3 or 5 years. Blocks logins, deposits and wagers at all licensees and stops marketing. Early removal procedure not published (UNVERIFIED).

administering_agency: Vermont Department of Liquor and Lottery
enrollment_method: Online (state form with selfie, ID and one-time code)
notes: Mobile sports wagering only (all Vermont licensees). Fantasy sports per-operator; lottery not covered. Terms 1, 3, 5 years or lifetime; fixed terms end automatically (re-enroll to stay excluded); lifetime cannot be removed; enrollee agrees not to petition during the term. DLL.PlayerExclusion@vermont.gov.

enrollment_method: Online (DocuSign, for 2- and 5-year terms) or in person (Lottery HQ or a casino, by appointment; lifetime must be in person)
notes: One list covering casinos, online sports betting, account-based (online) lottery, charitable gaming, and all horse wagering under the Racing Commission (live, OTB, historical horse racing, ADW). Retail lottery tickets not covered. Terms 2 years, 5 years or lifetime; cannot be removed until the term ends; removed automatically at expiry (contact the Lottery before expiry to extend). Distributed to all operators within 7 days; winnings forfeited to the Problem Gambling Treatment Fund. 804-692-7185.

administering_agency: Washington State Gambling Commission (card rooms); Washington's Lottery (lottery)
enrollment_method: In person at any house-banked card room or at the Commission (Lacey) by appointment, or notarized form by mail (or signed by a certified gambling counselor); no online option
notes: Commission program covers all privately owned house-banked card rooms statewide (since May 2022); tribal casinos run their own per-casino programs and do not participate. Terms 1, 3, 5 or 10 years; no early removal; NOT removed automatically at expiry — notice sent 45 days before, and a notarized removal form or in-person appointment is required to exit. Passport-style photo and ID copy by mail; forms in 11 languages. Separate Lottery Voluntary Self-Exclusion (prizes over $600, second-chance prizes, My Lottery 360; 1, 3 or 5 years) at https://www.walottery.com/responsibility/SelfExclusion.aspx. 360-486-3445.

enrollment_method: Notarized form by mail, or in person before Lottery security (no notary needed in person)
notes: Covers the four racetrack casinos and The Greenbrier plus all WV iGaming and mobile sports betting; iLottery is a separate in-app exclusion. Indefinite until removed; removal considered on written request after at least 1 year, Commission decides. The WV exclusion list is a public record (stated on the form). Photo ID copy required. The Lottery's web pages are script-rendered; the official form PDF is the stable URL.

administering_agency: Wyoming Gaming Commission, via the National Voluntary Self-Exclusion Program
enrollment_method: Online (nvsep.org)
notes: Wyoming routes state self-exclusion through NVSEP: covers online sports wagering, pari-mutuel/historical horse racing and Commission-regulated skill games. Tribal casino coverage UNVERIFIED. Term menu and reinstatement rules not legible on the official pages (UNVERIFIED; secondary sources say 1, 3, 5 years or lifetime).

enrollment_method: One enrollment and one remote notary appointment; every participating state closes at once. Operated by idPair.
participating_states: CA; WY; CO; NE; IA; WI; MI; LA; PR
